add_subdirectory(luajit)

if(CK_ENABLE_EDITOR)
    add_subdirectory(sqlite3)
    add_subdirectory(imgui)
endif()

if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug" OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Dev")
    foreach(VENDOR_LIB imgui sqlite3)
        if(TARGET ${VENDOR_LIB})
            message("=====")
            message(STATUS "CK: Stripping debug symbols from vendor lib: ${VENDOR_LIB}")
            message("=====")

            if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
                target_compile_options(${VENDOR_LIB} PRIVATE "-g0" "-Os" "-fno-sanitize=address")
                target_link_options(${VENDOR_LIB} PRIVATE "-g0" "-fno-sanitize=address")
            elseif(MSVC)
                target_compile_options(${VENDOR_LIB} PRIVATE "/Zd" "/Os")
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
